previous_description: A specification of which values from an InputSpacePartition must be exercised within a CoverageRequirement, supporting selective coverage of equivalence classes per IEEE 829-2008 test design specification. When coverAllCategories is true, all partition values are included except those in excludeValues; otherwise, only the values listed in coverValues are included.
definition: A coverage-scope rule within a CoverageRequirement that names exactly one InputSpacePartition and declares which of its PartitionValues must be exercised. The rule takes one of two forms: an explicit include list, or all values minus an exclude list. It selects equivalence classes and never binds concrete test data.

distinguish_from.when: a single partition value is bound to a concrete test datum for one specific TestCaseSketch, rather than a set of classes being declared in scope for a requirement.
you are defining the equivalence class itself (its label, constraint and representative value), not choosing which classes to cover.
the inclusion or exclusion of values in one field is conditional on a value chosen in another field.
you are stating the overall criterion (pairwise, boundary-values, MC/DC) and priority, rather than the per-partition value subset it draws on.

standard_reference: IEEE 829-2008 Level Test Design Specification (Clause 10), approach refinements: selection of equivalence classes to be exercised
code_evidence: A combinatorial test model file (e.g. a PICT .txt or ACTS model) that lists one parameter with only a subset of its defined value classes.
A test-design YAML/JSON block keyed by an input field or partition name, with include/exclude lists or an 'all: true, except: [...]' form.
A parametrized test (pytest.mark.parametrize, it.each, @EnumSource(mode = EXCLUDE)) iterating over one field's enum or equivalence classes, with specific classes deliberately omitted or excluded.
notes: coverValues and excludeValues are required comma-separated strings, although each is ignored in one mode; they should be optional arrays. They also duplicate the aggregates→partitionvalue relationship. Aggregating contextvariation belongs on CoverageRequirement, not here. Three composing parents make ownership ambiguous. The TestCaseSketch.inputSelections attribute points here, which invites confusion with InputSelection.
